float32_control_caveat: systems/*/system.py forces jax_enable_x64=True in load_target(); for the float32 arm x64 is forced back off afterward, but forward constants (image/PSF) were built float64 -> imperfect control. Trust energy_dtype_achieved + per-direction eps_f_empirical, not the 'float32' label.
eps_to_zmove_mapping: per-step z-move along unit e ~= eps_step * sigma_dir / sqrt(dim); full-trajectory ~= L * sigma_dir / sqrt(dim). MCLMC isokinetic velocity is unit-norm in the Sigma-metric (preconditioned) space, so one step of length eps moves eps in whitened norm; a single whitened axis carries ~eps/sqrt(dim), mapped to z along e by sigma_dir. Falsifier floor = eps_step_move/100.
